context: tablets are round, flat-faced, white to off-white tablets, 25 mm in diameter, with beveled edges, with "M" debossed on one side, containing 91.37 mg of alendronate sodium, which is equivalent to 70 mg of free alendronic acid. After dissolution the solution has a pH of 4.8-5.4.
